# VERTICAL HORIZON RACER

## How to Play
- **Arrow Keys** or **Touch Screen**: Steer left and right to stay on track
- **Spacebar** or **Tap Button**: Activate boost when available
- **Survive** as long as possible while the canyon scrolls upward!

Navigate tight turns, avoid obstacles, and collect turbo tokens for speed bursts. Watch your speed—too fast and you'll skid, too slow and you'll fall behind!
